cli_surface: Claude Code 2.1.240 --help; --print, stream-json input/output, --safe-mode, --no-session-persistence, and `claude setup-token` taking no options

packet_input.text: the exact immutable packet byte sequence

credential: a long-lived subscription OAuth token minted separately by `claude setup-token`; never the operator's keychain login, never an API key, and never read from the parent environment, a home directory or an auth file
credential_expiry: operator-configured: the command takes no options, prints no expiry and has no revoke, so kept refuses a dispatch that could outlive the token rather than discovering it dead mid-session
accepted_exposure: direct environment channel: a tool-capable agent inside the box can read CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from its own environment, accepted explicitly under decision 0017 because the alternative on macOS is a keychain grant that decision refuses outright
child_environment: clean: HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR under a freshly-created empty directory, plus exactly the credential environment entry; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is refused rather than passed, as is the rest of the credential-precedence family

projections.assistant.message.content[type=text].tex: transcript fragment when no streamed text arrived

admission: unadmitted: this deterministic fixture is not the required confined interrupted live session
refused_parent_environment: the whole ANTHROPIC_ namespace, plus the named CLAUDE_/CLAUDE_CODE_/CCR_ and transport variables that carry a credential, name settings that can carry an auth helper, redirect where the credential is sent, or switch to a provider with its own credentials. Read off the installed 2.1.240 binary's own auth-state report and strictPolicyHelperKeys set. Names are consulted, never values. A third-party credential store and NO_PROXY are excluded on purpose: the provider switch is what is refused, and NO_PROXY redirects nothing
